description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database visualization interface, including embedded CSS styling and JavaScript for dynamic data fetching and rendering.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's tables list and loads tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML table from data records.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
